posts.text: Q1 Result out, subsidiary business is doing extremely well Standalone Banco India: Revenue: ₹335.8 cr vs ₹296.8 cr → +13.1% PBT: ₹59.5 cr vs ₹63.7 cr → -6.6% PAT: ₹44.5 cr vs ₹47.9 cr → -7.1% So the Indian standalone business is actually not a good Q1. But consolidated: Revenue +21.8% PAT +11.7% That means the subsidiaries are contributing disproportionately to growth. If we roughly subtract standalone from consolidated: Subsidiary contribution to revenue Q1 FY27: ~₹837.6 cr Q1 FY26: ~₹666.4 cr Growth: ~25.7% Subsidiary contribution to PAT Q1 FY27: ~₹77.9 cr Q1 FY26: ~₹61.6 cr Growth: ~26.4% T…
